ⓘ
Symbols:
Cℓ⁡(η): normalizing constant for Coulomb radial functions, h⁡(ϵ,ℓ;r): irregular Coulomb function, π: the ratio of the circumference of a circle to its diameter, !: factorial (as in n!), Gℓ⁡(η,ρ): irregular Coulomb radial function, ℓ: nonnegative integer, ρ: nonnegative real variable and η: real parameter
